meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 让脚本自动操作浏览器并复用现有登录状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有一份已登录的浏览器会话,想通过脚本操作页面或取走登录凭证
copy.tagline_en: Control a browser with scripts and reuse an existing signed-in session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a logged-in browser and want to script it or grab the auth token.

howto.what: Claude 可以通过 CDP 控制 Chrome,复用你已登录的会话:打开网址、等待加载、执行 JavaScript、抓取页面文本和登录 token,并能点击、输入页面元素。首次启动会先探测状态,若你正在用 Chrome 会先征求同意。
howto.when: 当你提到「浏览器操作」「CDP」「复用登录态」等关键词,或要求用已有登录态做浏览器自动化时触发。另外需要本机装有 Chrome、Node.js 20+,并已全局安装 agent-browser。

say.text: 用 CDP 打开 https://example.com 并等页面加载完
从当前页面提取 localStorage 里的 token
列出当前页面的可交互元素,然后点第一个链接
say.note: 先 snapshot -i 拿元素引用再点击

howto.what_en: Claude drives Chrome over CDP, reusing your existing login sessions: open URLs, wait for load, run JavaScript, read page text and auth tokens, click or type on elements. It probes status first and asks before killing your Chrome.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention browser automation, CDP or reusing a login session, or ask to automate a browser with your existing session. Requires Chrome, Node.js 20+ and the agent-browser CLI.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com via CDP and wait for it to load
say_en.note: Probes CDP status and asks before closing your Chrome

say_en.text: Extract the token from localStorage on the current page
say_en.note: Returns the localStorage token or cookie

say_en.text: List the interactive elements, then click the first link
say_en.note: Runs snapshot -i then clicks the element
